title: Concept: Predictable randomness via Random.nextInt (kotlin) — review required
description: In kotlin, Random.nextInt is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only SecureRandom provides in kotlin.
applicability: kotlin codebases drawing random values through Random.nextInt; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
